title: Voice-based auditory AI assists clinicians assessing laryngeal disease before laryngoscopy
summary: An auditory large language model produced pre-laryngoscopy assessment cards and a malignancy alert from voice recordings. In a paired study with 32 clinicians and 800 assessments, accuracy rose from 49.8% to 56.8%, and sensitivity for precancerous or malignant lesions from 53.9% to 75.0%. The study is single-center and sequential, so AI assistance cannot be separated from reassessment; this is a preprint.
